how_to_apply: Visit the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in and submit the online application.
Print out a copy of the submitted online application.
Attach copies of educational qualifications and experience.
Enclose an undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw, if selected.
Enclose a self-attested Passport Size Photo of the candidate affixed on the application.

Ensure the application is forwarded through proper channel by the respective Port Authority to reach SECRETARY, CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY, RAJAJI SALAI, CHENNAI - 600 001 on or before 22.11.2026 along with ACRs/APARs, willingness certificate, No Objection Certificate, vigilance clearance, and other required documents.
important_instructions: Applications must be routed through proper channel so as to reach Chennai Port Authority on or before 22.11.2026. Applications received after the last date or without ACRs, APARs, or enclosures will not be considered. The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of receipt of applications (22.11.2026). The Port Authorities are requested to forward applications with complete details. The selected officer will be appointed on absorption / deputation basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Chennai Port Authority Executive Engineer (Civil)
content_sections.text: Visit the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in and submit the online application. Print out a copy of the submitted online application. Attach copies of educational qualifications and experience. Enclose an undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw, if selected. Enclose a self-attested Passport Size Photo of the candidate affixed on the application. Ensure the application is forwarded through proper channel by the respective Port Authority to reach SECRETARY, CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY, RAJAJI SALAI, CHENNAI - 600 001 on or before 22.11.2026 along with ACRs/APARs, willingness certificate, No Objection Certificate, vigilance clearance, and other required documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Copies of educational qualifications and experience Undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw, if selected Self-attested Passport Size Photo of the candidate affixed on the application Photocopy of ACRs / APARs of the applicant for the last 5 years duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Head of Department Willingness of the candidate for joining the post in case of selection No Objection Certificate of respective Port Authority Vigilance / Administrative Clearance of the Officer Veracity certificate of University Certificates and recognition of Degree Certificate if ACR / APAR for a particular year / period is not available Details of disciplinary case / penalty if any imposed during the last 10 years Complete service details of the applicant with posts held till date in Annexure-4
